# SetGadgetLayout

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetGadgetLayout:Void gadget:Int32, left:Int32, right:Int32, top:Int32, bottom:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of the gadget. |
| `left` | In | Int32 | required | Behavior of the left edge: 0, 1 or 2. |
| `right` | In | Int32 | required | Behavior of the right edge: 0, 1 or 2. |
| `top` | In | Int32 | required | Behavior of the top edge: 0, 1 or 2. |
| `bottom` | In | Int32 | required | Behavior of the bottom edge: 0, 1 or 2. |

## Description

Says how a gadget follows its group when it changes size. Each side can be 0 for free (the distance to that edge changes), 1 for locked (the distance stays) or 2 for proportional (it scales with the group). The default is left and top locked.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Resize me", 10, 10, 200, 150, Desktop(), 3)
box = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 170, 70, win)
SetGadgetLayout box, 1, 1, 1, 1
ok  = CreateButton("OK", 100, 90, 80, 28, win)
SetGadgetLayout ok, 0, 1, 0, 1
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
